support.p: Script: dpe tshugs. Last folio number: 98. The scribe skipped "4" when numbering the folios. Missing folio: 93. Fols. 36 and 37 occur on the same page, so do fols. 41 and 42. Numerous abbreviations. Contrary to (ID:5990), does not seem to include glosses identifying the persons whose views are being cited.
